Taxonomy of NCBI taxids from a local database

Source: R/get_tax.R
get_tax.Rd

Looks up the NCBI taxonomy of taxids in a local SQLite database: no internet, no efetch, thousands of taxids in a few seconds. Returns the minimal table, with one row per distinct taxid, to be joined to the BLAST hits by taxid.

x can be a vector of taxids or any result of parallel_blast() (long or wide) or parallel_blast_hsps(): the taxids are taken from the staxid, k_staxid and Taxids at best identity columns. Unknown taxids (0, empty, N/A) are dropped.

When the database does not exist, it is built from the NCBI taxdump (downloaded once, then reused). If x is a BLASTr result, the taxdump is the first one the NCBI published after the date of its BLAST database, so the taxonomy matches the database; the database is kept in the BLASTr cache as taxonomy_<database date>.sqlite. With only taxids and no database set, the newest database in the cache is used, or one is built from the current taxdump.

The database has the tables nodes (id, rank, parent) and names (id, name, scientific, type), as built by make_taxonomy_db() (or by taxonomizr::prepareDatabase(), whose file can be used as is). Build it from the NCBI taxdump of the same date as the BLAST database: taxids newer than the taxdump are not found.

Usage

get_tax(x, taxonomy_db = NULL, ranks = tax_ranks_default, taxdump = NULL)

Arguments

x

Taxids (character or numeric) or a BLASTr result.

taxonomy_db

Path to the SQLite taxonomy database. NULL uses the option BLASTr.taxonomy_db or the environment variable BLASTR_TAXONOMY_DB; with none set, a database in the BLASTr cache (see below). If the file does not exist, it is built.

ranks

Ranks returned as columns. "domain" is also filled from "superkingdom", its name in taxdumps before 2025.

taxdump

NCBI taxdump used to build a missing database (see make_taxonomy_db()). NULL: the taxdump matching the BLAST database of x (the first monthly NCBI archive after its date), or the current one.

Value

A tibble with one row per taxid: taxid, found (FALSE when the taxid is not in the database), sci_name, rank (rank of the taxid itself), one column per rank in ranks (NA when the lineage has no node of that rank), lineage (all the nodes from the root to the taxid, without "root" and "cellular organisms", separated by "; "), lineage_taxids (their taxids, in the same order, for an exact lowest common ancestor) and merged_into (the current taxid when the NCBI merged the taxid into another one; then the taxonomy is that of the current taxid; needs a database with the table merged, as built by make_taxonomy_db()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
options(BLASTr.taxonomy_db = "/data/databases/tax/nameNode.sqlite")
get_tax(c("9606", "10090"))

res <- parallel_blast(seqs, db_path = "/data/databases/core_nt/core_nt")
tax <- get_tax(res)
dplyr::left_join(res, tax, by = c(staxid = "taxid"))
} # }
